args.title: Mitigation summary: 429 add_observations rate limit (Sev3)
args.content: Mitigation for Sev3 429 rate limiting on memory_modify:add_observations: client retries caused observation spam and hit the 20 obs/hour cap. Implement exponential backoff and include an idempotency key per batch to prevent duplicate writes during retry storms.
